claims.statement: For the mapping class group Mod_{g,n} of a closed orientable surface of genus g>=2 with n punctures/marked points, the virtual cohomological dimension is vcd(Mod_{g,0})=4g-5 and vcd(Mod_{g,n})=4g-4+n for n>=1. Consequently rational/orbifold cohomology of M_{g,n} vanishes in degrees strictly larger than this vcd.

In every case 2d-16 <= vcd, so none of the open inputs lies strictly above vcd.

Vanishing-above-vcd cannot discharge any RED-0001 ordinary open input: H^k(M_{g,n};Q)=0 is guaranteed only for k>vcd, whereas each residual degree equals vcd or vcd-1. In particular any claim that H^{2d-16}(M_{g,n})=0 for (3,12),(5,8),(6,6),(7,4),(8,0),(8,1), or (8,2) on the sole grounds of Harer vcd is false.

The proposed residual ordinary groups W_{2d-16}H^{2d-16}(M_{g,n}) for the RED-0001 pairs are not formulated incorrectly with respect to degree versus vcd: all seven degrees are admissible (at or one below vcd). For the packet case (6,6), degree 26 equals vcd 26, matching the packet target ordinary_cohomology_degree.
